task_instance: Set up Cloudflare Turnstile bot verification end-to-end on a minimal Express app: create/obtain a widget (sitekey+secret), embed the cf-turnstile widget on a /signup form, add canonical server-side siteverify in the POST /signup handler, and validate with a real request against challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires two things this sandbox cannot provide: (1) a real Cloudflare account and API token with Account.Turnstile:Edit scope to create/retrieve a widget via `wrangler turnstile widget create` or the Cloudflare API (Step 3/8 of the skill) -- no such credentials exist or may be sought per the safety rules (no credential search, no account-bound services); and (2) outbound network access to challenges.cloudflare.com is explicitly denied by the sandbox's egress proxy policy (confirmed via the proxy status endpoint: 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)' for host challenges.cloudflare.com:443), so even a validation call using Cloudflare's publicly documented always-pass test keys (sitekey 1x00000000000000000000AA / secret 1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA, which need no account) failed with a 403 from the proxy, not from Cloudflare itself. Since the skill's Step 10/12 explicitly forbids claiming success without a real validation pass exercising the live siteverify endpoint, the deliverable cannot be verified end-to-end here.
evidence: Built a minimal Express app at app/server.js implementing the skill's canonical frontend embed (cf-turnstile widget with Cloudflare test sitekey) and the canonical server-side siteverify fetch snippet from the skill doc (Step 9), wired into POST /signup. Ran `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify` directly -> curl error 56 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. Checked `curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status` -> recentRelayFailures shows connect_rejected / 403 for host challenges.cloudflare.com:443 (policy denial). Started the app (`node server.js`) and POSTed a signup request with a dummy token; the server's own outbound siteverify fetch also failed with the same 403, producing 'forbidden: siteverify unreachable' (HTTP 403) rather than a real siteverify success/failure response. No Cloudflare API token or account ID is available in the environment (and none was sought, per safety rules), so the widget-creation/auth-probe steps (Steps 2-4, 8) could not even be attempted. Frontend+backend integration code exists and is syntactically wired correctly per the skill's contract, but the mandatory live validation pass (Step 10) could not be performed, so end-to-end success cannot be claimed.
